Teaching history

Courses

Selected academic records

Courses are listed from most recent to earliest. Records from 2022 to 2026 were checked against the teaching archive’s syllabi. For older records, dates follow the CV and do not imply continuous course offerings.

2026 · Second semester
IESP–UERJ and UFRGS · Graduate

A extrema direita no século XXI: impactos eleitorais, partidários e agendas políticas

English title: The Far Right in the Twenty-First Century: Electoral and Party Impacts and Policy Agendas

The rise of the far right in comparative perspective, focusing on Brazil and Germany: elections, parties, communication and policy agendas.

A jointly taught course within the PROBRAL project, with faculty from IESP–UERJ, UFRGS and the universities of Rostock and Würzburg.

2026 · Second semester
IESP–UERJ · PhD in Political Science

Seminário de Projeto de Tese

English title: Doctoral Research Proposal Seminar

Development of a doctoral research proposal: formulating the research problem, reviewing the literature, organizing references and writing the introduction.

2026 · First semester
IESP–UERJ · Graduate

Política brasileira

English title: Brazilian Politics

Institutions and transformations in Brazilian politics since the New Republic, with research on elections, representation, polarization, the justice system, media and public policy.

With Leonardo Avritzer and guest researchers.

2025 · Second semester
IESP–UERJ and UFRGS · Graduate

Crise da democracia e direita radical

English title: Democratic Crisis and the Radical Right

Democratic crisis, institutional erosion, populism and the rise of the radical right, with case studies from Brazil, Germany and Latin America.

With Leonardo Avritzer and Silvana Krause, and guest researchers from the PROBRAL project.

2024 · Second semester
IESP–UERJ · Graduate

Liberdade de expressão e equidade em perspectiva democrática

English title: Freedom of Expression and Equity in Democratic Perspective

The foundations of freedom of expression and its relationship with equality, democracy, justice, tolerance and recognition, considering inequalities in access to communication.

With San Romanelli Assumpção and Renato Francisquini.

2024 · First semester
IESP–UERJ · Graduate

Crise da democracia, ascensão da extrema direita e bolsonarismo no Brasil

English title: Democratic Crisis, the Rise of the Far Right and Bolsonarismo in Brazil

Literature on democratic crisis, the international rise of the far right and Bolsonarismo, combining comparison, critical analysis and hypothesis development.

2023 · Second semester
IESP–UERJ · PhD in Political Science

Seminário de Projeto de Tese

English title: Doctoral Research Proposal Seminar

Development of a doctoral research proposal through readings, discussion of literature reviews and presentations of abstracts, introductions and research proposals.

2022 · Second semester
IESP–UERJ · Graduate

Desigualdades Raciais e Justiça

English title: Racial Inequality and Justice

Normative theories of justice and their relationship with racial inequality, human rights, recognition, tolerance and democracy.

With San Romanelli Assumpção.

2022 · First semester
IESP–UERJ · Doctoral studies in Political Science and Sociology

Estudos Exemplares em Ciências Sociais

English title: Exemplary Studies in the Social Sciences

Key works in Sociology and Political Science organized around the theme of democracy and representation.

Coordinated with José Szwako, with invited faculty from IESP–UERJ.
